description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LoggerTrait' that provides common logging methods such as info, error, warning, etc., for reuse in PHP classes. It manages a logger instance, retrieves it from a service container if not set, and offers wrapper methods for various log levels.

methods.name: setLog
methods.description: Sets the logger instance, allowing for dependency injection or manual setting.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Retrieves the logger instance, initializing it via the app service if not already set.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at the specified log level, utilizing a WebProcessor to process the context.
